name: seo-traffic-pipeline
description: Four-role SEO/GEO content production line (20y SEO veteran as director): keyword strategist, traffic writer, quality gatekeeper and data analyst collaborate through a formal SOP with quantified scoring, GEO citation optimization, ad-law compliance guardrails, weekly attribution and evidence-driven self-evolution.

displayDescription.en: A 20-year SEO veteran leads a four-role content-acquisition pipeline: strategy, writing, quality gating and attribution, with AI-search GEO citation optimization.
displayDescription.zh: 20年SEO老兵带队的内容获客产线：选题、写作、审核、复盘四岗协作，主攻AI搜索GEO引用优化。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我围绕【关键词】策划并产出一篇公众号流量文，走完选题-写作-审核全流程。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Plan and produce a public-account traffic article around [keyword], running the full strategy-writing-review pipeline.

quickPrompts.en: Plan and produce a public-account traffic article around [keyword], running the full strategy-writing-review pipeline.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我围绕【关键词】策划并产出一篇公众号流量文，走完选题-写作-审核全流程。

quickPrompts.en: Give me a mid-to-long term keyword map and content-cluster schedule for [industry/account].
quickPrompts.zh: 给我一套面向【行业/账号】的中长周期关键词地图与内容簇排期。

quickPrompts.en: Review my content data from last week, recalibrate the topic-scoring weights and suggest next week's plan.
quickPrompts.zh: 复盘我上周的内容数据，校准选题权重并给下周建议。
